t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are different gnomes and they have different colours, the red, orange, blue and green gnomes take you to the bright forest, whereas the pink, purple, yellow and brown gnomes take you to the dark forest. It is important to be aware that each forest has a different number of mushrooms so you need to be wise with your choices. Additionally the x1 or x5 doesnt make any difference in the forest choice, however it does impact your score so make sure you are more careful with your choice when this appears. The size of the gnomes hat has no difference.

vb_textbox.text: So the gnomes have different colours and will always appear in the same coloured pair e.g. blue gnome on and purple gnome. However, depending on which gnome you chose will depend which forest it will lead you to. The colour gnomes:RedGreenOrange Blue Clicking on these gnomes will lead you to the forest with a red basket.The colour gnomes:Pink PurpleYellowBrownClicking on these gnomes will lead you to the forest with a yellow basket. Initially start off finding which set on gnomes takes you to the forest with the most number of mushrooms, then keep selecting on the gnomes in that category(e.g. yellow basket colours). I felt it useful to keep repeating the set of colours in my head so I selected the correct group.It is also important that when it is x5 you select the colour gnome which had been forreging the highest number of mushrooms. At times you will need to change it up (for example the group with the yellow basket now gets you very few mushrooms or none, then start chosing the colour gnomes with the red basket. It can be difficult to find what the pattern is, and I did not find a definate pattern, however if you see that the red basket gnomes forrege the most mushrooms then keep selecting. Additionally the size of the gnome hats makes no difference, so just focus on the colours you are selecting Hope this helps :)
